newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Siu-Fung shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Siu-Fung shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of ceramics and machinery maker Siu-Fung Ceramics Holdings Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Monday.
Shares of Siu-Fung Ceramics fell HK$0.02 or 3.39 percent to end at HK$0.57 per share on Friday.

The company said earlier in October that it would postpone a proposed HK$400 million rights issue for about one month and it had also begun talks regarding the disposal of certain assets and subsidiaries and the rearrangement of certain bank borrowings.
